checks.title: the rows are the letter's, in its order, the chosen one marked

steps.script: (() => { const rows = [{"id": "b1", "title": "Шапка · Логотип", "icon": "image", "family": "header"}, {"id": "b2", "title": "Заголовок", "summary": "Осенняя рассылка", "icon": "title"}, {"id": "b3", "title": "Текст", "summary": "Здравствуйте! Рассказываем…", "icon": "notes"}, {"id": "b4", "title": "Кнопка", "summary": "Подробнее", "icon": "smart_button"}, {"id": "b5", "title": "Подвал · Простой", "icon": "view_agenda", "family": "footer"}]; const one = document.querySelector('#structure'); one.rows = rows; document.querySelector('#none').rows = [rows[0], rows[4]]; globalThis.heard = []; for (const name of ['select','move','insert','add','duplicate','delete','replace']) one.addEventListener('sf-mail-structure-' + name, (event) => globalThis.heard.push([name, event.detail])); return true; })()
